dataset: Evaluation and Management (E/M) Codes by Specialty
publisher: CMS, Medicare Part B Physician/Supplier National Data
privacyScreen: CMS leaves out rows with fewer than 11 allowed services
transform: Rows of the benchmarked E/M families (office new and established, nursing facility initial and subsequent, home new and established, hospital inpatient or observation initial and subsequent) with a specialty; allowed services kept as published; rows without a specialty dropped; sorted by specialty, family and level
